title: nf-demultiplex-matfet samplesheet schema
description: One row per library. Libraries sharing a group_id come from one pregnancy and are demultiplexed together. Enforced in main.nf (parseSamplesheet); this file documents the same contract.

group_id.errorMessage: group_id must be provided: the pregnancy group (one mother, one fetus). A group may hold a single library.

sample_id.errorMessage: sample_id must be provided, unique across the samplesheet, and contain only letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'.

bam.errorMessage: bam must be a path to a .bam file with cell barcodes.

barcodes.errorMessage: barcodes must be a (optionally gzipped) filtered cell-barcode file.

expression.errorMessage: expression must be a CellRanger filtered_feature_bc_matrix directory.

sample_role.errorMessage: sample_role must be 'mixture'; 'maternal_reference' is not supported yet.

expected_genotypes.errorMessage: expected_genotypes must be 2 (one mother, one fetus).

souporcell_dir.errorMessage: souporcell_dir, if given, must be an existing per-library Souporcell output directory with alt.mtx, ref.mtx, barcodes.tsv and common_variants_covered.vcf.
